name: Positive Booking Flow - Positive_Standard_Booking_1 -- @1.1

steps.name: Given User navigates to the MakeMyTrip Home Page
And User dismisses the login popup
When User clicks on the Hotels module
And User searches for the hotel destination "Hyderabad"
And User selects the stay dates
And User configures guests and applies the settings
And User triggers the search query
And User selects the first available hotel
And User clicks book now on the hotel details page
And User fills guest details for "John" from the test data
And User handles the secure my trip option and continues
Then User should safely transition to the checkout page

fullName: Hotel Booking Validation Suite: Positive Booking Flow - Positive_Standard_Booking_1
